The Management Study Program at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya (UPJ) is here to produce graduates who are competent, innovative, and ready to face challenges in the ever-evolving business world. With a practice-based curriculum and strengthened theoretical concepts, we prepare students to become business leaders who are able to contribute in various industrial sectors.
We offer advantages such as an industry-based curriculum, qualified and experienced lecturers, modern facilities (including the latest management software), and extensive networks with companies and professional institutions. One of UPJ's unique features is the Living Laboratory supported by Jaya Group, providing students with hands-on learning opportunities from real business practices. In addition, UPJ also has collaboration programs with industries to ensure students get relevant practical experience.
Students can choose from various concentrations, such as Marketing Management, Financial Management, Human Resource Management, and Entrepreneurship.
Uniqueness
Discover UPJ's Management Program!
What sets UPJ Management Program apart? We offer a dynamic, innovative approach that you'd be hard-pressed to find elsewhere.
Industry Approach
The Management Study Program at UPJ focuses on an industry approach, preparing you to excel in the world of business and entrepreneurship.
Entrepreneurship
Our curriculum is designed to make you an expert in managing businesses and entrepreneurship. You will learn important fields such as human resources, marketing, and finance, as well as learn to utilize modern technology to make smart decisions and drive business success.
Living Lab
One of UPJ's unique features is the Living Lab supported by the Jaya Group, providing students with the opportunity to learn directly from real-world business practices. Through this collaboration, you will gain in-depth practical experience, understand industry dynamics, and build professional networks from an early stage.
Join us and be part of a unique and dynamic Management program!

Future Career
Graduates of the UPJ Management Study Program have bright career prospects, such as:
Marketing Manager - Design and manage business marketing strategies.
Financial Analyst - Analyze financial data for decision making.
HR Specialist - Managing human resource development.
Entrepreneur - Building and developing your own business.
Business Consultant - Providing strategic solutions for the company.
Business Development Manager - Identifying business opportunities and market expansion.
Join Management UPJ and make your dreams come true!

Secretary and Lecturer of Management Department
Dr. Chajar Matari Fath Mala, S.E., M.M. completed her undergraduate studies in Accounting at Universitas Jenderal Soedirman and earned her Master of Management degree from Universitas Indonesia. She later pursued and successfully obtained her Doctoral degree in Islamic Banking from UIN Syarif Hidayatullah Jakarta.
She currently serves as a lecturer and holds the position of Secretary of the Management Study Program at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya. In addition to her teaching responsibilities, she is actively involved in academic research and community service initiatives. Her scholarly contributions have been published in a wide range of national and international journals, covering both research findings and community engagement projects.
With a background in management and Islamic finance, she continues to build a multidisciplinary academic portfolio, integrating theory and practice to contribute to the advancement of financial knowledge and education. She is also frequently engaged in collaborative projects that bridge academia with industry and society, reflecting her commitment to applied research and sustainable community development.

Lecturer of Department Management
Dr. Mohamad Zein Saleh, S.H., M.M. earned his Bachelor of Law degree in 1990 from Universitas Pancasila with a specialization in International Civil Law, pursued a Master of Management degree in 2001 from Universitas Bhayangkara Jakarta Raya, and later completed his Doctoral degree in Management Science in 2022 from Universitas Negeri Jakarta.
Before entering academia, he accumulated more than 25 years of extensive professional experience in the industry, particularly in Sales and Marketing, as well as in various other functions including Legal, Human Resources, Business Development, and Learning and Development. He has held strategic roles in several major corporations, such as Telekomunikasi Indonesia, Singapore Telecommunications (SingTel), and PT Multistrada Arah Sarana Tbk—a tire manufacturing company producing the Achilles and Corsa brands, which since 2019 has been part of Michelin France, one of the world’s leading tire producers.

She earned her bachelor’s degree in Jakarta and her Master of Science in Finance from Universiti Utara Malaysia in Kedah, Malaysia. Her academic journey has provided her with a strong foundation in both the theoretical and practical aspects of finance, enabling her to develop a deep understanding of the complexities of financial management, financial behavior, and the rapidly evolving field of financial technology.

Head of Finance and Investment Laboratory and Lecturer of Management Department
Zulkifli, S.E., M.M. earned his Bachelor of Economics degree in 2014 and his Master of Management degree in 2016, both from Universitas Mercu Buana. His educational background has provided him with a solid foundation in economics and management, equipping him with both theoretical knowledge and practical skills to support his professional and academic contributions.
Before becoming a lecturer, he was a practicing Stock Trader in the Capital Market. Currently, he is the advisor of the investment gallery and capital market for students. In the field of teaching, he teaches many courses related to financial management, capital markets, and statistics.
He has conducted many studies analyzing the internal factors that affect financial performance and firm value in Indonesia. In the pharmaceutical sector, his research was to understand sustainable dividend policy. Meanwhile, another study highlighted mining companies, which emphasized the importance of capital structure and profitability in revenue growth. In the region, he also conducts comparative analysis that opens up insights into capital market performance across countries. In the post-pandemic context, his research provides a new perspective on corporate adaptation to financial stress.

content:
Visi & Misi :: Universitas Pembangunan Jaya (UPJ)
Visi & Misi
Vision
Menjadi Program Studi Manajemen yang unggul dalam memajukan ilmu pengetahuan dan teknologi di bidang urban development dan urban lifestyle, serta membentuk manusia Jaya sebagai lifelong learner yang bermartabat dan berintegritas, yang memberi manfaat bagi masyarakat dan lingkungan.
Mision
Menyelenggarakan pendidikan yang berkualitas di tingkat Sarjana dan Pasca Sarjana dalam lingkup Manajemen di bidang kajian urban yang bersifat kolaboratif dan multidisiplin untuk menghasilkan lulusan yang unggul dan mampu memberikan solusi Inovatif dan kreatif.
Menghasilkan penelitian yang unggul terutama dalam bidang kajian urban dan diakul di tingkat nasional maupun internasional di bidang Manajemen.
Memberikan impak terhadap masyarakat umum dan DUDI (Dunia Usaha dan Dunia Industri) melalui karya dan praktik profesional di bidang Manajemen.
Menjadi tempat untuk menumbuh kembangkan manusia Jaya yang berintegritas, profesional, dan mempunyai jiwa pembelajar sepanjang hayat (lifelong learner) yang memberi manfaat bagi masyarakat dan lingkungan.
Objective
Mewujudkan program studi yang unggul dalam tata kelola, program akademik dan kurikulum yang kompetitif di bidang Manajemen dan mampu bersaing dengan universitas lain di Asia Tenggara.
Menciptakan atmosfer akademik dan budaya akademik di bidang Manajemen sebagai universitas riset.
Menghasilkan ilmu pengetahuan, teknologi dan seni yang unggul di bidang urban lifestyle and urban development di bidang Manajemen.
Menghasilkan pembelajar seumur hidup (lifelong learner) yang memiliki rasa ingin tahu yang tinggi, berpikir logis dan kritis, giat menerapkan keilmuannya di bidang Manajemen.
Menghasilkan lulusan bermartabat dan berwawasan luas, kreatif, inovatif, tanggap terhadap perubahan serta berkontribusi nyata mengatasi masalah lingkungan dan kesejahteraan di bidang Manajemen.
Menghasilkan percepatan keunggulan komparatif UPJ melalui sinergi dan kolaborasi di bidang Manajemen.
Strategy
Strategi pencapaian tujuan disusun berdasarkan analisis yang sistematis sebagaimana dituangkan dalam dokumen Rencana Strategi Program Studi Manajemen
Targets
Meningkatnya kualitas dan kuantitas dosen dan mahasiswa di bidang Manajemen.
Meningkatnya relevansi dan kualitas pembelajaran di bidang Manajemen.
Meningkatnya kapasitas inovasi, kualitas dan produktivitas penelitian dan pengabdian kepada masyarakat serta pusat unggulan universitas di bidang Manajemen.
Meningkatnya kuantitas dan kualitas partnership Lembaga di bidang Manajemen.

Kuliah Umum Dengan tema STRATEGI BUMN DI ERA VUCA :: Universitas Pembangunan Jaya (UPJ)
Kuliah Umum Dengan tema STRATEGI BUMN DI ERA VUCA
Kuliah Umum dengan tema "Strategi BUMN di Era VUCA" menghadirkan perspektif yang relevan bagi dunia bisnis dan manajemen di tengah tantangan ketidakpastian global. VUCA, yang merupakan singkatan dari Volatility, Uncertainty, Complexity, dan Ambiguity, mengacu pada lingkungan bisnis yang tidak stabil dan sulit diprediksi. Dalam kuliah ini, para narasumber yang berasal dari sektor BUMN memberikan wawasan mengenai strategi adaptif yang telah diterapkan untuk tetap bertahan dan berkembang dalam situasi yang penuh gejolak.
Kuliah ini mencakup berbagai pendekatan strategis seperti penguatan tata kelola perusahaan, inovasi bisnis, digitalisasi, serta penerapan manajemen risiko yang efektif. BUMN berperan penting dalam mendorong perekonomian nasional, dan dalam menghadapi era VUCA, mereka perlu berinovasi dengan cepat, meningkatkan efisiensi, serta membangun kemitraan strategis baik di dalam negeri maupun global.
Dengan adanya diskusi ini, mahasiswa diharapkan mampu memahami dinamika baru dalam manajemen perusahaan serta menyiapkan diri untuk menghadapi tantangan yang kompleks di masa depan. Kuliah ini tidak hanya memberikan wawasan teoritis, tetapi juga studi kasus nyata dari beberapa BUMN terkemuka di Indonesia yang telah berhasil menavigasi era VUCA dengan sukses.

Dengan kurikulum berbasis praktik dan penguatan konsep teoritis, kami mempersiapkan mahasiswa untuk menjadi pemimpin bisnis yang mampu berkontribusi dalam berbagai sektor industri.
Kami menawarkan keunggulan seperti kurikulum berbasis industri, dosen berkualitas dan berpengalaman, fasilitas modern (termasuk software manajemen terkini). Selain itu, UPJ juga memiliki program kolaborasi dengan industri untuk memastikan mahasiswa mendapatkan pengalaman praktis yang relevan.
Mahasiswa dapat memilih dari berbagai konsentrasi, seperti Manajemen Pemasaran, Manajemen Keuangan, Manajemen Sumber Daya Manusia, dan Kewirausahaan.

Apa yang membedakan UPJ Program Manajemen ? Kami menawarkan pendekatan dinamis dan inovatif yang sulit Anda temukan di tempat lain.
Pendekatan Industri
Program Studi Manajemen di UPJ berfokus pada pendekatan industri, mempersiapkan Anda untuk unggul di dunia bisnis dan kewirausahaan.
Kewirausahaan
Kurikulum kami dirancang untuk menjadikan Anda ahli dalam mengelola bisnis dan kewirausahaan. Anda akan mempelajari bidang penting seperti sumber daya manusia, pemasaran, dan keuangan, serta belajar memanfaatkan teknologi modern untuk mengambil keputusan cerdas dan mendorong kesuksesan bisnis.
Living Lab
Salah satu keunggulan unik UPJ adalah Living Lab yang didukung oleh Jaya Group, memberikan mahasiswa kesempatan untuk belajar langsung dari praktik bisnis nyata. Melalui kolaborasi ini, Anda akan mendapatkan pengalaman praktis yang mendalam, memahami dinamika industri, dan membangun jaringan profesional sejak dini.
Bergabunglah bersama kami dan jadilah bagian dari program Manajemen yang unik dan dinamis!

Karir masa depan
Lulusan Program Studi Manajemen UPJ memiliki prospek karir yang cerah, seperti:
Manajer Pemasaran – Merancang dan mengelola strategi pemasaran bisnis.
Analis Keuangan – Menganalisis data keuangan untuk pengambilan keputusan.
HR Specialist – Mengelola pengembangan sumber daya manusia.
Entrepreneur – Membangun dan mengembangkan bisnis sendiri.
Konsultan Bisnis – Memberikan solusi strategis bagi perusahaan.
Business Development Manager – Mengidentifikasi peluang bisnis dan ekspansi pasar
